_comment: Pinned Whisper models for the portable ZIP build (scripts\build.ps1 -Model <name>).
'revision' is a HuggingFace commit SHA, never a branch name: 'main' would let the
bundled model change under us between builds, which is exactly what pinning is for.
'sha256' is verified by build.ps1 with Get-FileHash AFTER huggingface_hub has
downloaded the snapshot. The two steps deliberately do not share a failure mode:
snapshot_download handles the LFS/Xet redirect, retry and resume that a hand-rolled
download of a 461 MB file would get wrong, while the independent hash check means a
corrupted or swapped file cannot ship.
Every file listed here must be present and must match. faster-whisper's own
but these repos do not ship one - _get_feature_kwargs falls back to defaults - so it
is not listed and not required.
To add a model: run scripts\build.ps1 -Model <name> -WriteHashes, review the printed
values against huggingface.co, then paste them here.
